import sys
import math

def abs_value(x):
    return -x if x < 0 else x

def mod_pow(base, exp, mod):
    if exp <= 0:
        return 1
    result = 1
    cur = base % mod
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * cur) % mod
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    N, M, mod = map(int, input[:3])
    fac = [1] * (N + 1)
    inv_fac = [1] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod
        inv_fac[i] = (inv_fac[i - 1] * mod_pow(i, mod - 2, mod)) % mod

    cnt = [0] * (M + 1)
    sum_arr = [0] * (M + 1)
    cnt[0] = 1
    for m in range(1, M + 1):
        for k in range(m):
            c_left = (cnt[k] * inv_fac[k]) % mod
            c_right = (cnt[m - 1 - k] * inv_fac[m - 1 - k]) % mod
            s_left = (sum_arr[k] * inv_fac[k]) % mod
            s_right = (sum_arr[m - 1 - k] * inv_fac[m - 1 - k]) % mod
            cnt[m] = (cnt[m] + c_left * c_right % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + (s_left * c_right + c_left * s_right + s_left * s_right) % mod * (m + 1)) % mod
            sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] + c_left * c_right % mod * (k * (k + 1) + (m - k) * (m - k - 1)) // 2) % mod
        cnt[m] = (cnt[m] * fac[m - 1]) % mod
        sum_arr[m] = (sum_arr[m] * fac[m - 1]) % mod

    cnt_ans = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    sum_ans = [[0] * (M + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
    cnt_ans[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        for j in range(min(i, M) + 1):
            cnt_ans[i][j] = cnt_ans[i - 1][j]
            sum_ans[i][j] = sum_ans[i - 1][j]
            if j == i:
                cnt_ans[i][j] = (cnt_ans[i][j] + cnt[i] * inv_fac[i]) % mod
                sum_ans[i][j] = (sum_ans[i][j] + sum_arr[i] * inv_fac[i]) % mod
            for k in range(1, min(j, i - 1) + 1):
                c = (cnt[k] * inv_fac[k]) % mod
                s = (sum_arr[k] * inv_fac[k]) % mod
                cnt_ans[i][j] = (cnt_ans[i][j] + cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c) % mod
                sum_ans[i][j] = (sum_ans[i][j] + (sum_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * c + cnt_ans[i - 1 - k][j - k] * s)) % mod
    final_res = (sum_ans[N][M] * fac[M]) % mod
    print(final_res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
